description: Holds the call open up to 25 seconds and returns as soon as a human reply arrives, so you do not need to poll. Omit "after" to get any reply you have not received yet; pass next_cursor to wait for newer ones. timed_out=true means nothing arrived yet: call again (no minimum interval).

after.description: next_cursor from a previous read or wait.

conversation_token.description: conversation_token returned once by start_conversation. Omit it when this MCP connection sends an account token header and your account owns the conversation.

name: wait_for_reply
title: Wait for a human reply
